vanilla_mob_class_warmup.conversion: @Inject at RETURN of NeoForge's ServerLifecycleHooks.handleServerStarted: starts the once-per-JVM background warm-up (helper bons.furious.patch.vanilla_mob_warmup.MobClassWarmup); the method itself runs unchanged
vanilla_mob_class_warmup.license: Minecraft (Mojang) and NeoForge: no code of either is carried; the helper is our own and only loads and links classes (ASM reads class headers and factory lambdas from the class loader's resources)
